payload.prompt: Registre una nota de gastos de viaje para Laura López (laura.lopez@example.org) por "Visita cliente Oslo". El viaje duró 2 días con dietas (tarifa diaria 800 NOK). Gastos: billete de avión 3700 NOK y taxi 200 NOK.

payload.goal: Registrar una nota de gastos de viaje para Laura López por un viaje de 2 días con dietas y gastos de avión y taxi.
success_checks: Existe un empleado con email laura.lopez@example.org o se crea uno para Laura López
La nota de gastos de viaje se crea con descripción "Visita cliente Oslo"
Se registran 2 días de dietas a 800 NOK por día
Se registran los gastos de billete de avión por 3700 NOK y taxi por 200 NOK
El total de la nota refleja 5500 NOK si no hay ajustes adicionales
risk_notes: No se indicó fecha del viaje; puede ser obligatoria para registrar la nota
No se indicó moneda explícita en campos del sistema; se asume NOK por los importes
No se indicó tratamiento de IVA para avión y taxi; puede requerir clasificación manual
En sandbox vacío puede ser necesario crear primero el empleado si no existe
ordered_steps: Search employee by email via employee endpoint
If not found, create employee with name Laura López and email laura.lopez@example.org via employee endpoint
Create travel expense header for employee with description "Visita cliente Oslo" via travel expense endpoint
Add allowance line for 2 days at 800 NOK per day via travel expense lines endpoint
Add expense line for billete de avión amount 3700 NOK via travel expense lines endpoint
Add expense line for taxi amount 200 NOK via travel expense lines endpoint
Validate total amount and save/submit the travel expense

payload.headline: Travel expense created successfully but scoring returned None/None — no checks defined or scoring issue.
what_went_wrong: Scoring returned score_raw=None/None with 0/0 checks passed, suggesting the task had no verifiable checks or a scoring system issue — outcome unclear.
costCategory endpoint was called 3 times (duplicate calls) before creating the expense, wasting API calls without finding the right category.
Dietas (per diem allowance) was posted as a /travelExpense/cost instead of /travelExpense/allowance, which may be semantically incorrect for per diem entries.
GET /travelExpense/rateCategory was called after the expense was already created, suggesting poor upfront planning of required lookups.
what_worked: Employee found correctly on first attempt via GET /employee with no errors.
Travel expense header and all 3 cost lines were created with 0 HTTP errors.
what_to_try_next: Use /travelExpense/allowance endpoint for per diem (dietas) entries instead of /travelExpense/cost, as allowances have dedicated rate/day fields.
Consolidate costCategory lookups into a single GET /travelExpense/costCategory call before creating any resources to eliminate 2 redundant calls.
Investigate why scoring returned None/None — verify the task's expected checks and whether the travel expense ID or structure matches what the scorer expects.
unnecessary_calls: GET /travelExpense/costCategory (2nd call at 19:23:11) — duplicate of first call, no new info obtained.
GET /travelExpense/costCategory (3rd call at 19:23:18) — another duplicate, should have cached first result.
